title: compile.ts: text field with filters drops filter list when it moves between keyframes
description:
In compile.ts, the isFirst placement path for TextDisplayObject (lines ~1779-1791) correctly checks hasEnabledFilters and emits PlaceObject3. However, the posChanged path (lines ~2202-2234) does NOT check for filters — it always emits PlaceObject2 via encodePlaceObject2WithCXForm or encodePlaceObject2Move.

Result: if a text field with Flash 8 filters (drop-shadow, glow, blur, etc.) is animated (position tween) across keyframes, the filter is present on frame 1 but silently dropped on every subsequent frame where the position changed.

Fix: in the posChanged branch for displayObj.type === 'text', add a hasEnabledFilters(displayObj.filters) check before the CXForm check, and emit PlaceObject3 via encodePlaceObject3WithFilters (passing the name if any). Mirror the isFirst text+filters path at lines 1779-1791.
